homeLede: The released index of the Commission, set as plain pages. No workstation is required.
homeIntro: Every entry the Commission has released is listed here, with its designation, its class, and the date it was filed. Open an entry to read the record.
homeIntroNote: Records that are sealed, restricted, or held appear in the index and do not open to their filings.
homeBrowseNote: Eighteen entries are on file, in four classes.
homeLatestNote: The five most recent entries, newest first.
homeOrganizationsNote: Bodies that hold filings in this index.
homeWorkstationNote: The interactive edition opens records in a viewer, with annotations and the records filed against them. It is not required for reading.
indexLede: Every entry the Commission has released, in archive order.
indexNote: A designation is withheld where the releasing office withheld it. The code remains listed so that it is not reused.
recordWorkstationNote: The interactive edition opens this record in a viewer, with its annotations and follow-up strip.
recordHeldBody: The index entry is released. The filing itself is held at the desk.
orgLede: Bodies that hold filings in the released index.
orgNote: An organization is an entry in the directory; it is not a personnel account.
orgSearchPlaceholder: Code, designation, or words from the abstract
orgSearchResults: {count, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}} for “{query}”
orgCount: {count, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}} in the directory
aboutLede: What this page is, and how to read it.
aboutKeyHint: A class opens the index filtered by it. The code is a released example.
aboutStatusHint: A status opens the index filtered by it.
aboutBody: This is the public reading edition of the Commission's index. It carries the same entries as the workstation, without the workstation: every record has a page of its own, and every page can be read in any browser.
aboutUseBody: Entries are listed by code. A record opens on its own page with its particulars and the records filed against it. A designation that is withheld in the index stays withheld here, and a filing that is held at the desk does not open.
aboutClassIncidentBody: A reported event and its measurement.
aboutClassOrganizationBody: A body entered in the directory.
aboutClassContinuityBody: A branch held by an organization.
aboutStatusSealedBody: Held at the desk; only the index entry is released.
aboutStatusErasedBody: Removed from discovery; the entry remains as a tombstone.
aboutClearanceBody: Classification describes the record, not the correspondent.
aboutWorkstationBody: The interactive edition runs on the Commission's workstation. Records open there in a viewer with annotations, a rating, and the records filed against them.
bannerText: The reading room is unstaffed until 09:00. Records remain open, and the index is current to 14.11.2003.
classifiedFoot: Unauthorized personnel will be tracked, located, and detained
searchPlaceholder: Code, designation, or words from the abstract
searchHint: The index is searched by code, designation, class, status, and abstract.

filteredCount: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} shown
popularNote: Consultations recorded by the reading room this quarter.
randomNote: The archive will open a record it has not shown you.
downloadHeld: No copy is held for this filing.
notesLead: Annotations are part of the public record. Correspondents may file a note below.
noteComposerHint: Held in this browser only. The reading room files it under your name before it joins the public record.
